title: Local daemon config
description: Stored at ~/.resolvroom/config.json. Written by `resolvroom init` and `resolvroom pair`. Agents can never read or write it (hard deny list).

listen.description: The daemon binds only to the Tailscale interface of this machine, never to 0.0.0.0.

ceiling.description: Highest mode this machine will ever grant to anyone. Default: ask.

auto_requires_tag.description: When true (default), a peer can only run in auto mode if its Tailscale node carries tag:resolvroom-auto.

peers.description: Allowlist. A peer that is not listed here is refused, even if it has the right Tailscale tag.
